---
title: Themes
description: Apply Radix Themes foundations and stateless view helpers in Foldkit.
section: Themes
order: 1
---

`@wsagency/wseffect-themes` provides design tokens, CSS, and thin stateless Foldkit view helpers. Install the package with its peers: `pnpm add @wsagency/wseffect-themes@0.1.0-rc.1 @wsagency/wseffect-foldkit@0.1.0-rc.1 @wsagency/wseffect-foldkit-ui@0.1.0-rc.1 effect@^4.0.5 @effect/platform-browser@^4.0.5`.

Import the complete stylesheet once with `import '@wsagency/wseffect-themes/styles.css'`. Components receive props, child nodes, and the configured builder; the helpers do not own application state. Menus, dialogs, and tabs use the companion Foldkit UI behavior as appropriate. Start with [CSS](/themes/css/), [responsive styles](/themes/responsive/), [portals](/themes/portals/), or [accessibility](/themes/accessibility/). The [component API index](/themes/components/) links generated component references. See [interactive examples](/demos/).
